svg.title: The Rim — gate network of the Ten Banners
svg.desc: Star chart of 100 systems, 133 physical gate links and 25 hub routes across five bands. Node color marks the holding faction; node opacity fades from band 0 to band 4. Solid lines are physical gates; dashed amber lines are one-way hub routes.
svg.text: THE RIM — GATE NETWORK OF THE TEN BANNERS
100 SYSTEMS · 133 PHYSICAL GATES · 25 HUB ROUTES · NODE OPACITY FADES FROM BAND 0 (COREWARD) TO BAND 4 (RIMWARD)
Hub system · node opacity fades with band
